Tesla community still doesn’t fully understand how big this is.

@NICKIMINAJ hasn’t done a public appearance like this in 3 years.

She’s not just stopping by. She’s doing a fireside chat + meet & greet at X Takeover inside Tesla Giga Texas on 10/10.

What most people miss is how similar these two communities actually are:
• Ride-or-die loyalty
• Built through years of outside hate and skepticism
• Follow leaders who stay unapologetic no matter the pressure
• Strong online cultures that move fast and protect their own

The Barbz and Tesla owners colliding at the factory isn’t random. It’s two of the most dedicated fanbases meeting in the same room.

Oct 10 is going to hit different. 🚀🎀
